messages:
liam_cs: Heads-up: Nebula Systems wants to change the renewal to a 9-month term (prorated) and add a vendor code on the PO. Procurement also asks for our vendor tax ID on the invoice. Looping Jordan and Finance/Legal.

jordan_sales: Any pricing impact for 9 months vs 12? They mentioned wanting the same annual price but shorter term.

liam_cs: They asked for same ARR pro-rated to 9 months. Sales approved a one-time pro-rata comp of 25% off the quarterly stub to match budget. Need approvals from finance/legal for amended terms.

sofia_finance: Finance can accept prorate and vendor code but need: vendor code, billing email, tax ID copy if tax jurisdiction requires it. Also confirm if we should issue a single invoice with a note or two separate invoices.

rachel_legal: If the customer requests term length change and pricing comp, we'll do a short amendment plus an approval memo. I need the exact amendment language and the approver name for the discount.

liam_cs: Customer provided vendor code: VEND-9921 and billing@nebulasys.com. Tax ID attached in their procurement email. Approver for discount: Jordan (account exec) signed off.

jordan_sales: Confirmed. I approve the 25% pro-rate comp. Can Legal add language: "9-month term, effective on renewal date, pricing as set forth in Amendment A"? Also we need dual signature: Customer wants both VP Ops and Procurement Director to sign.

rachel_legal: Dual signature ok, but add: "Execution by either signatory constitutes full agreement" or specify both must sign? Which do they want?

liam_cs: Customer reply: both will sign. Procurement insists both signatures are present on DocuSign.

sofia_finance: Finance note: we'll include vendor code VEND-9921 in invoice metadata and the tax ID on the invoice footer. We'll issue a single invoice for the 9-month charge referencing PO# 7734 and vendor code. Net30 terms requested. Please confirm net terms.

jordan_sales: Customer asks Net30. I'm ok with Net30 for this customer.

rachel_legal: Drafting Amendment A now with the term change and discount approval line. Adding clause for dual signatures: "This Amendment shall be executed by both parties and will become effective upon countersignature by both signatories."

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope drafted by rachel_legal for 'Nebula Renewal Amendment A' - envelope id NBL-2026-77. Status: created.

liam_cs: Pushed envelope to customer. Procurement will sign first, then VP Ops. Notifying procurement contact.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope NBL-2026-77 signed by procurement@nebulasys.com at 2026-03-01T09:22:11Z. Status: partial.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign: Envelope NBL-2026-77 signed by vops@nebulasys.com at 2026-03-01T09:45:30Z. Status: completed.

liam_cs: Received signed amendment PDF. Uploading to contract record and sending to Finance.

sofia_finance: Received PDF. Creating invoice INV-2026-NBL-001 referencing PO# 7734, vendor code VEND-9921, tax id in footer, net30. Scheduling send for tomorrow and attaching signed amendment.

rachel_legal: Amendment merged into contract. No further redlines. Document saved under contract id CTR-7755.

liam_cs: Closing: 9-month prorated renewal executed, dual-signed amendment, vendor code included, finance to send invoice Net30. Actions: 1) Upload signed doc to SFDC. 2) Finance send INV-2026-NBL-001. 3) Update customer billing contacts and vendor code field.

liam_cs: Thanks team :sparkles:
